subject: maths
question: The profit earned by selling an article for Rs. 832 is equal to the loss incurred when the article is sold for Rs. 448. What will be the selling price of the article if it is sold at a 10% loss?
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price at profit = Rs. 832

The selling price at loss = Rs. 448

Required loss = 10%

**Formula used:**

S.P. = (100 - Loss%)/100 × C.P.

Where, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price</p&g
